WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta_p(t) = R * [t - T_CBS]^+, with R = IdleSlope = 0.75*C, T_CBS = Lmax_p * (C - R) / (C * R)

WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD(flow) = sum_{ports on path} D_p + (#hops)*PropagationDelay + (#switches)*SwitchingDelay + (#switches)*TimeSyncError

CBS.t_recover: (C - I_S)/I_S * tau_block = (|SendSlope|/IdleSlope) * tau_block = (1/3) * tau_block at 75% I_S

all_parameters_used.arrival_curve_model: alpha_f(t) = sigma_f + rho_f * t, with sigma_f = L_f_bits, rho_f = L_f_bits / T_f_us
all_parameters_used.CBS_service_curve_per_egress: beta_e(t) = R * [t - T0_e]^+, with R = IdleSlope = 75 bits/us, T0_e = Lmax_e / R

WCD_calculation.per_egress_leftover_service: For an egress e and tagged flow f in set S_e: R_f,e = R - sum_{g in S_e \ {f}} rho_g; latency L_f,e = T0_e + (sum_{g in S_e \ {f}} sigma_g) / R_f,e. Using FIFO/arbitrary multiplexing bound, the per-hop delay is D_f,e = (sigma_f + sum_{g in S_e \ {f}} sigma_g) / R_f,e + T0_e = (sigma_total_e) / (R - sum_{g != f} rho_g) + T0_e.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum_over_egresses_e_on_path(D_f,e) + N_links * propagation_delay + N_switches * switching_delay + time_synchronization_error

CBS_parameters_used.T0_e: T0_e = Lmax_e / IdleSlope (us) for each egress e

missing_inputs: Exact L2/L1 overheads (preamble, SFD, IFG, headers) not specified; payload used as frame size
Whether end-stations also shape with CBS (assumed only switch egresses considered)

No frame preemption (802.1Qbu) specified; assumed non-preemptive serialization within class

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_per_flow: alpha_i(t) = b_i + r_i * t, with b_i = 8 * payload_i [bits], r_i = (8 * payload_i) / period_i [bits/us]

CBS_parameters.L_A_max: max payload over all Class A flows = 1450 B = 11600 bits

WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta_p(t) = R_p * (t - T_p)^+ with R_p = I and T_p = (L_A_max/c) + ((c - I) * L_A_max)/(c * I) + t_sw + t_prop + t_sync
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound: D_p = T_p + (B_p) / (R_p - r_p), where B_p = sum of bursts of all Class A flows on port p, r_p = sum of rates of those flows
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD_per_flow: WCD_i = sum over all egress ports p on the flow's path of D_p

WCD_calculation.equation: For a flow f with hop set H(f), WCD_f = sum_{h in H(f)} [ T_cbs(h) + Sigma_h / (R - Rho_h) + (t_prop + t_sw + t_sync) ], where R = IdleSlope, Sigma_h=sum of burst sizes (bits) of all class-A flows on egress port h, Rho_h=sum of rates (bps) of those flows, T_cbs(h)=Lmax_h/C, and C is line rate.

Aggregate, arbitrary multiplexing bound applied per port: delay contribution = T_cbs + Sigma/(R - Rho).

equations.end_to_end_delay_bound: WCD_i <= sum_over_egress_ports_on_path(T_p + b_i/(R - r_i)) + hop_count * (d_prop + d_switch + d_sync)

loCredit_p = -((C - I)/C) * L_maxA_p (bits)
T_cbs_p = |loCredit_p| / I = ((C - I)/(C*I)) * L_maxA_p = L_maxA_p / 300 (us)
T0_p = T_sw + T_prop + T_sync + T_cbs_p = 3 + L_maxA_p/300 (us)
beta_p(t) = R * max(0, t - T0_p), with R = I = 75 b/us
D_port = sigma_sum_p / (R - rho_sum_p) + T0_p, valid if rho_sum_p < R
WCD(flow) = sum_over_egress_ports_on_path(D_port) + 1us (for the first source->switch propagation)
notes: Rates are expressed in bits per microsecond (b/us): 100 Mbps = 100 b/us

Cut-through switching: no store-and-forward serialization delay added beyond Network Calculus service term.

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve: For each flow i: alpha_i(t) = b_i + r_i * t, where b_i = 8*L_i [bits], r_i = 8*L_i / T_i [bps], L_i in Bytes, T_i in seconds.
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve: Per egress port p (AVB Class A): beta_p(t) = I * max(0, t - tau), I = IdleSlope = 0.75*C, tau = T_sw + 2*(L_block/C).
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound: D_p = b_sum_p / I + tau, where b_sum_p = sum of bursts of all AVB_A flows using port p.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_i = sum_{p in egress_ports(path_i)} D_p + hop_count_i * T_prop + T_sync_error.

all_parameters_used.arrival_curve_per_flow: alpha_i(t) = b_i + r_i * t with b_i = L_i (bits), r_i = L_i / P_i (bits/us)

equations: alpha_i(t) = L_i + (L_i / P_i) * t
For each egress port p: B_p = sum_{k on p} L_k; Lmax_p = max_{k on p} L_k
CBS service (lower bound) per port: beta_p(t) = I * (t - T_p)+, with I = IdleSlope, T_p = Lmax_p / C_line + Vmax / I; here Vmax = 0
Per-port delay bound (blind multiplexing): d_p = T_p + B_p / I
Fixed per-hop additive delay: D_fixed_per_hop = Propagation + Switching + SyncError = 1 + 1 + 1 = 3 us
End-to-end WCD for flow i: WCD_i = sum_{p in path(i)} d_p + (hop_count(i) - 1) * D_fixed_per_hop
notes: All flows are AVB Class A (PCP=6) using the same queue 6; no higher-priority traffic and no lower-priority traffic modeled, hence Vmax = 0
Non-preemptive blocking incorporated via T_p = Lmax_p / C_line
Frame size equals given payload; no L2 overhead added (not provided)

all_parameters_used.arrival_curves_per_flow: For flow i with payload L_i (Bytes) and period P_i (us): alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i * t, with sigma_i = L_i, rho_i = L_i / P_i (Bytes/us).
all_parameters_used.per_port_service_curve: Lower-bounded CBS service per egress port: beta_e(t) = R * [t - T_e]^+, with R = IdleSlope * C = 9.375 B/us, and T_e = 1us (switch) + 1us (propagation) + 1us (time sync error) = 3us.

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve: For each flow i: alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i t, with sigma_i = L_i (Bytes), rho_i = L_i / P_i (Bytes/us), where L_i is payload and P_i is period (us).
WCD_calculation.aggregate_at_port: At egress port e: Alpha_e(t) = sum_i alpha_i(t) over all flows using port e. Stability requires sum_i rho_i < R (satisfied for all ports).
WCD_calculation.cbs_service_curve: beta_e(t) = R [t - T_e]^+ with R = 0.75 * 12.5 = 9.375 B/us and T_e = 3 us (switch + propagation + sync). SendSlope S_S = I_S - C = -3.125 B/us (used to report CBS parameters; not needed in the rate-latency bound here).
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound: D_e <= (sum_i sigma_i)/R + T_e, where sum_i sigma_i is the sum of payloads (Bytes) of all flows traversing egress port e.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: For flow f with path consisting of ports e in path(f): WCD_f <= sum_{e in path(f)} D_e.
WCD_calculation.units: All delays in microseconds (us); rates in Bytes/us.

WCD_calculation.aggregate_per_port: For egress port p, alpha_p(t) = B_p + r_p * t with B_p = sum(M_i over flows on p), r_p = sum(r_i over flows on p).
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta_p(t) = I * (t - T_p)^+ with I = IdleSlope (75 b/us). T_p = T_credit + t_sw + t_prop + t_sync, where T_credit = M_max_p * (C - I) / (C * I) = M_max_p / 300 [us] (here C=100 b/us, I=75 b/us). t_sw=1us, t_prop=1us, t_sync=1us.
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound: D_p = B_p / (I - r_p) + T_p, valid for r_p < I.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: For flow k over ports p in its path: WCD_k = sum_{p in path(k)} D_p.

equations: alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i * t, where sigma_i = 8 * payload_i (bits), rho_i = sigma_i / period_i (bits/us)

T_overhead = t_switch + t_prop + t_sync = 1 + 1 + 1 = 3 us (per switch egress port)
T_credit_port = Lmax_port_bits * (C - r) / (C * r) = Lmax_port_bits / 300 (us)
beta_port(t) = r * max(0, t - (T_overhead + T_credit_port)) (bits)

End-to-end worst case delay for flow f: WCD_f = sum_{ports p on f's path} D_port(p)

CBS_service_curve.T_derivation: T = L_block/C + |loCredit|/I, with loCredit = -((C - I)/C) * L_block
CBS_service_curve.simplified_T: T = L_block/100 + L_block/300 = L_block/75 (us when L_block in bits)

blocking_and_credit.blocking: non-preemptive blocking by at most one Class-A frame on the egress (max size among flows using that egress)

equations.arrival_curve: alpha_i(t) = L_i + (L_i / T_i) * t  (bits, t in us)
equations.CBS_send_slope: SendSlope S = IdleSlope I - LinkRate C
equations.CBS_service_curve: beta(t) = R * [t - T]^+, with R = I
equations.CBS_latency_T: T = L_block/C + |loCredit|/I, where loCredit = -((C - I)/C) * L_block
equations.per_port_delay_bound: D_port = T + sigma / (R - rho), with sigma = sum L_i, rho = sum(L_i/T_i) over flows using that egress
equations.end_to_end_WCD: WCD = sum_over_egresses(D_port) + Fixed_delays, Fixed_delays = (1us prop + 1us sync) for first hop + (1us prop + 1us sync + 1us switching) for each switch egress hop

WCD_calculation.per_port_CBS_service_curve: beta_port(t) = R * [t - T_port]^+, with R = IdleSlope and T_port = t_switch + t_prop + (L_max_bits / C) + (|SendSlope| * L_max_bits / (C * IdleSlope))
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_service_curve: beta_e2e(t) = R * [t - sum_i T_port_i]^+; with identical ports this becomes R * [t - n * T_port]^+
WCD_calculation.WCD_formula: WCD_f = n * T_port + sigma_f / (R - rho_f), provided rho_f < R

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_per_flow: alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i * t, with sigma_i = payload_i [B], rho_i = payload_i / period_i [B/us]
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta_p(t) = [ R * (t - T_fixed) ]_+, with R = IdleSlope = 9.375 B/us, T_fixed = propagation(1us) + switching(1us) = 2us
WCD_calculation.residual_service_for_flow_i_on_port_p: R_i^p = R - sum_{j != i} rho_j; T_i^p = T_fixed + (sum_{j != i} sigma_j) / R_i^p
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound: D_i^p = sigma_i / R_i^p + T_i^p = (sum_{j in F_p} sigma_j) / (R - sum_{j != i} rho_j) + 2
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_i = (sum over traversed egress ports p of D_i^p) + time_sync_error (1us)
notes: All rates in bytes per microsecond (B/us); 100 Mbps = 12.5 B/us; IdleSlope = 75 Mbps = 9.375 B/us; SendSlope = -3.125 B/us
Cut-through switching is modeled via fixed 1us switching delay per switch; propagation 1us per link; both lumped into per-port T_fixed = 2us
Only AVB Class A on queue 6 is considered; no BE/other classes included
